why_it_fails: Same failure class as Dutchess: website discovery picks a sibling branch. The search for 'Maribis Westchester' returned maribisllc.com/stores/maribis-denver (Springfield) and a Chicago Dutchie page; inspect_page marks them conflict/candidate, and the correct /stores/maribis-westchester page was never fetched. There is no CONNECTORS entry for 'maribis' (resolution #198 'No retailer locator connector configured'), and the hub page maribisllc.com/ that links all four branch slugs is never walked. The Dutchie side (dispensaryId in SSR HTML, whole-menu paging, 505 = 505) would work once the right page is found.
fix_idea: Shared with Dutchess/Stashouse: add ('maribis', 'https://www.maribisllc.com/') to CONNECTORS or build a generic 'chain hub -> /stores/<slug> -> Dutchie dispensaryId' locator that matches the registry address to the page JSON-LD (here exact) and emits dutchie.com/embedded-menu/<dispensaryId>. When the search returns a sibling-branch URL on a host that is a chain hub, walk the hub for the slug whose JSON-LD street matches. Also make fetch of maribisllc.com/locations/* tolerant (403 interstitial) by preferring the /stores/* storefront.
